purpose: Project-independent conventions for building plugins that combine SKILLs and custom Agents: naming, invocation paths, defense layers, skill invocation, and waiting for Agent completion.

Decision order for choosing an invocation path

Custom Agent requirements: frontmatter, prohibitions, write boundaries
Multi-layer defense table: Agent boundary, role constraint, allowlist, deny
Invoke other skills via Skill tool; never self-invoke
Do not wait for Agent completion with ScheduleWakeup
